title: Fresh outside consultant provides durable strategic advice
description:
As a human stakeholder, I want to launch an independent outside consultant in a fresh session, so that strategic contradictions, major risks, and opportunities are recorded without changing delivery authority.

Feature: Outside consultant advisory workflow

Scenario: Fresh-session consultation
Given a human starts a fresh session with a premium advisory profile and an existing Kanbus anchor
When the outside-consultant skill is invoked
Then it inspects repository and Kanbus evidence and posts targeted comments before an indexed anchor synthesis

Scenario: Spawned invocation refuses
Given a parent or subagent assigns the outside-consultant role
When the role checks its session topology
Then it refuses before analysis or Kanbus writes and requests a fresh human-facing session

Scenario: Significant advice is dispositioned
Given a finding is a strategic contradiction or major risk
When the consultant posts it
Then the Product Owner or Engineering Lead replies adopt, defer, reject, or investigate

Scenario: Failed writes remain truthful
Given a Kanbus comment write fails
When the consultant reports its output
Then it labels the exact draft UNPOSTED and does not claim the comment exists

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Behavior is represented by the landed outside-consultant skill and verified by six-skill validation, focused repository tests, and a fresh-context spawned-role refusal test.
